name: Bizzabo API connector
description: Connects Drupal to the Bizzabo event API to fetch and display an events listing.
project_description:
Bizzabo is a event management software that helps organizers create, manage, and promote professional events. This Module is to connect and list the Bizzabo events into Drupal system.

 Features 
 Connecting through Authentication Key generated from Bizzabo App itself. Able to list the events thorough API calls.

 Post-Installation 
 1. Navigate to `Administration > Configuration > Bizzabo Client Configuration` for configuration.

 Use API Configure tab to input the required params.

Input the Baseurl For The Event API - ex: https://api.bizzabo.com/api/events 

Input the bearer token in Authorization Key for the API.

 and hit the Save configuration button.

 2. You can test the API by hitting the Test Connection button in Test Connection Tab. Once the test was successful you will received the params from the API, which is going to be listed in /bizabo/fetch/events.

 Features to be included later 
 - Get the details of Individual Event.

- Registration to the events.

- Attendee Information.
